defs.def: being the amount or number after everyone or everything is counted or added together 总的；总计的；全体的；全部的

ex.s: Our courses, totalling 20,000 hours of content in 20 different languages, guarantee you language skills you can use right away.
ex.t: 我们的课程总计2万小时内容，涵盖20种不同的语言，保证你掌握可立即使用的语言技能。

ex.s: If the consumer has X amount of money and wants to buy two goods A and B, she can only purchase goods totaling X.
ex.t: 如果消费者有X金额的钱并且想购买两种商品A和B，她只能购买总计X的商品。

ex.s: In total, 25% of India’s working-age population has no education.
ex.t: 总的来说，印度25%的工作年龄人口没有受过教育。

ex.s: Lighting accounts for about 7% of the total electricity consumed in the US.
ex.t: 照明约占美国总用电量的7%。

ex.s: A total of 92 women were in the medium fitness category; and 59 women were in the low fitness category, defined as a peak workload of 80 watts or less, or having their exercise tests stopped because of high blood pressure, chest pain or other cardiovascular problems.
ex.t: 共有92名女性属于中等健康水平；59名属于低健康水平，定义为峰值负荷80瓦或以下，或因高血压、胸痛或其他心血管问题而停止运动测试。

ex.s: A total of 40 women met the criteria for a high fitness level, or 120 watts or higher.
ex.t: 共有40名女性达到高健康水平标准，即120瓦或更高。

ex.s: “We affect only a very small percentage of the total moisture in the air, so we cannot be causing drought,” Dr Krauss says.
ex.t: 克劳斯博士说："我们只影响空气中总湿度的极小一部分，因此不可能造成干旱。"

defs.def: including everything 彻底的；完全的

ex.s: The printed book is not totally out of date.
ex.t: 印刷书并没有完全过时。

ex.s: The researchers then tested the dogs’ ability to distinguish between human facial expressions by showing them the other half of the person’s face or images totally different from the ones used in training.
ex.t: 然后研究者通过给狗看那个人脸的另一半、或完全不同于训练所用图像，来测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: And that’s totally fine.
ex.t: 而那完全没问题。

ex.s: Our relationship, in and out of school, has been totally unpredictable.
ex.t: 我们的关系无论在校内还是校外都完全不可预测。

ex.s: It was totally, completely enough for him.
ex.t: "我热爱跳舞，"爱荷华州一家舞蹈工作室的老板莱斯特·布里奇斯说。

ex.s: Lindsey’s husband was totally    54    by the unexpected visit.
ex.t: 林赛的丈夫对这次意外拜访完全54。

ex.s: In 2030, a sixth of the country’s potential work force could be totally uneducated.
ex.t: 到2030年，该国潜在劳动力中可能有六分之一完全未受教育。

ex.s: Total concentration on new books.
ex.t: 完全专注于新书。

ex.s: She has driven through 55 mph winds in Wyoming, heavy flooding and storms in Alabama and total whiteout conditions in Kansas.
ex.t: 她曾在怀俄明州55英里时速的大风中、在阿拉巴马州的严重洪水和风暴中、以及在堪萨斯州完全白茫茫的天气条件下开过车。

ex.s: A simple greeting in their mother tongue can guarantee a smile from a total stranger and a tired traveller.
ex.t: 用他们的母语简单问候一句，就能让一个完全陌生的人和疲惫的旅客露出微笑。

ex.s: Since the effects were small, this may suggest that our creative thinking does not differ that much in response to total silence and 85 decibels of background noise.
ex.t: 由于影响很小，这可能表明我们的创造性思维在完全安静和85分贝背景噪音下的反应并没有太大不同。

ex.s: But since the results at 70 decibels were significant, the study also suggests that the right level of background noise—not too loud and not total silence—may actually improve one’s creative thinking ability.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝下的结果具有显著性，该研究也表明，适当的背景噪音水平——不太吵也不完全无声——实际上可能提升一个人的创造性思维能力。

ex.s: Interviewer: Yes, I totally agree.
ex.t: Interviewer ：是的，我完全同意。

ex.s: Because I thought ballet was more or less the same everywhere, I was totally unprepared for its unique beauty.
ex.t: 因为我原以为芭蕾舞无论在哪里都大同小异，所以对它独特的美毫无准备。

ex.s: The original reading was either forgotten or so totally absorbed that the new chance encounter with the text produced surprise and astonishment.
ex.t: 最初的阅读要么被遗忘了，要么被完全吸收，以至于再次偶然遇到这段文字时产生了惊讶和震撼。

ex.s: It was very exciting and totally unforgettable.
ex.t: 这非常令人兴奋，完全令人难忘。

defs.def: to reach a particular total 总数达；共计

ex.s: It is said that about 20% of 25-34-year-olds live with their parents, compared with 16% in 1991.The total number of all multigenerational households in Britain is thought to be about 1.8 million.
ex.t: 据说，25-34岁的人中约20%和父母同住，而1991年这一比例是16%。英国所有多代同堂家庭的总数估计约为180万。

ex.s: He became a total embarrassment.
ex.t: 他成了一个十足的尴尬存在。

ex.s: According to the World Bank, China accounts for about 30 percent of total   67   (globe) fertilizer consumption.
ex.t: 根据世界银行，中国约占全球____67____（globe）化肥消费总量的30%。

ex.s: To note this you make a dot at the number 15 (for total movie tickets) at the extreme left-hand side of the chart.
ex.t: 为标注这点，你在图表最左侧的数字15（电影票总数）处点一个点。

ex.s: At the start of this year, foreigners living in Italy amounted to 4.56 million of a total population of 60.6 million, or 7.5 percent, with immigrants’ children accounting for an even larger percentage of births in Italy.
ex.t: 今年年初，居住在意大利的外国人达456万，占总人口6060万的7.5%，而移民子女在意大利出生人口中所占比例甚至更高。

ex.s: Never!” _3 “My fridge is a total mess!
ex.t: 绝不！”_3 ＂我的冰箱简直是一团糟！

ex.s: It's good for… There's… off the total price.
ex.t: 它有利于…… 总价有……的优惠。

ex.s: If a basketball star is. for example，trying to gain a high personal point total，he may take a shot himself when it would be better to pass the ball to a teammate，affecting the team's performance.
ex.t: 例如，如果一个篮球明星试图获得更高的个人得分总数，在把球传给队友可能更好的情况下，他可能会自己投篮，从而影响球队的表现。

defs.def: to add up the numbers of sth/sb and get a total 把 … 加起来；计算 … 的总和

ex.s: the total area of our country
ex.t: 我们国家的总面积

ex.s: By taking off these, she was able to   42   the new total to the amount of cash she had with her.
ex.t: 通过去掉这些，她能够把____42____的新总额和她手头的现金对上。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

defs.def: to damage a car very badly, so that it is not worth repairing it 彻底毁坏（汽车）
